2608.03970.title: Should We Type or Talk to LLM Agents? A Comprehensive Study of Voice and Keyboard Input Perturbations
2608.03970.paper_summary: Human input reaches language models by typing or speaking, and each channel leaves a distinct signature: orthographic noise for keyboards; for voice, disfluency from conventional transcription and restructuring from AI-backed dictation tools. How do they impact an LLM's performance? In this paper we present HIVE (Human Input-Variation Engine), a suite of voice transcription perturbations and QWERTY keyboard perturbations. We use HIVE to evaluate how robust models are to these perturbations. We present seven findings. (i) Voice transcription perturbations lower accuracy across every instruction-tuned model we test, and it is the structure of the transcription rather than its fillers that carries the cost. (ii) QWERTY keyboard perturbations cost less, and a model absorbs a lot of them before accuracy falls away. (iii) Both trace back to one cause, how many of the question's tokens survive the perturbation: destroying a token is what hurts, while adding new ones alongside it costs little. (iv) The gap between the two channels appears only where the answer must be constructed or deduced; on multiple choice there is none. (v) The harm does not solely come from test-set contamination. (vi) It cannot be trained away with lightweight adaptation. (vii) A thinking budget recovers the keyboard channel almost entirely but leaves the spoken registers untouched, and compressed speech is worse with it.
2608.03970.paper_summary_zh: 人類輸入通過打字或說話進入語言模型，每個通道都留下獨特的特徵：鍵盤的拼寫噪音；對於語音，則是傳統轉錄中的不流暢性和AI支持的口述工具的重組。這些如何影響LLM的表現？在本文中，我們介紹HIVE（人類輸入變異引擎），這是一套語音轉錄擾動和QWERTY鍵盤擾動。我們使用HIVE來評估模型對這些擾動的穩健性。我們提出七個發現。(i) 語音轉錄擾動降低了我們測試的每個指令調整模型的準確性，而影響的主要原因是轉錄的結構而非其填充詞。(ii) QWERTY鍵盤擾動的成本較低，模型在準確性下降之前能吸收大量擾動。(iii) 兩者都追溯到一個原因，即問題的標記有多少在擾動中存活：破壞一個標記才是造成傷害的原因，而在旁邊添加新的標記則成本很小。(iv) 兩個通道之間的差距僅出現在答案必須被構建或推導的情況下；在多選題中則沒有。(v) 這種損害不僅僅來自測試集的污染。(vi) 這無法通過輕量級的適應來消除。(vii) 思考預算幾乎完全恢復了鍵盤通道，但對口語註冊沒有影響，且壓縮語音的效果更糟。
